case: custom enum[] grid editing distinguishes SQL NULL from an empty array
contract: The app grid parser maps a blank nullable enum-array cell to SQL NULL and preserves the array text `{}` as an empty array value.
The live keyed update path stores SQL NULL and an empty enum array distinctly, with their native type and JSON/wire results checked independently.
The nonempty enum-array edit, invalid-label no-mutation result and sibling-row wire bytes remain verified by the same focused contract.
